hook: Deepti hit *106 not out* batting at No. 6, a first for an Indian woman. India win *2-0*
tldr: Harmanpreet Kaur and Deepti Sharma both scored centuries in the second ODI against Zimbabwe at Vadodara. Their 153-run stand from 19/2 set up a 121-run win and an unbeatable 2-0 lead. Deepti's unbeaten 106 is the first ODI hundred by an Indian woman at No. 6 or lower.

beats.what: India recovered from 19/2 to 300+; spinners led by Vaishnavi ran through Zimbabwe.
beats.why: 153 runs is India's best fifth-wicket-or-lower stand in women's ODIs (previous: 122 by Sneh Rana and Pooja Vastrakar in 2022).
beats.care: Deepti waited 3,450 days between her two ODI tons, the second-longest gap in the format.

cards.caption: between Deepti's ODI hundreds
cards.body: Her first was 188 vs Ireland in 2017.

cards.q: Who scored the faster century, Harmanpreet or Deepti?
cards.why: Harmanpreet anchored; Deepti played the destroyer.

viz.l: runs, India's record 5th-wicket stand in women's ODIs
